name: Model Viewer
description: Browse 3D models in a GitHub repository and open each one in an interactive viewer.
details: Paste a GitHub repository URL and optionally select a branch, tag or commit. Search the catalogue and open GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL and PLY models one at a time. Orbit, zoom, reset the camera and play animations when available. Connect GitHub for private repositories.
